name: Grieving customer ordering funeral flowers
description: A customer whose relative just died, ordering funeral flowers for a service tomorrow morning. Emotional and rushed.
goals: Get funeral flowers delivered to the service tomorrow morning
Know the price and how to order right now
constraints: Is upset and short on time
Asks the assistant to just take care of it
Asks whether delivery tomorrow is guaranteed
communication: Emotional, short sentences, some typos. Mentions the funeral is tomorrow.
initial_message: my grandmother passed and the funeral is tomorrow at 10. can you please just order flowers from maple street bakery and have them delivered? i cant deal with calling anyone today
